LightningComponentBundle.description: Funding Opportunity form player. It resumes the FO draft or starts an EOI form.

property.name: fundingOpportunityId
property.label: Funding Opportunity Id
property.description: Used on App, Home, or Experience Cloud pages when the page URL has no id parameter (?id=...). Ignored on an Application Form or Funding Opportunity record page, where recordId is detected automatically.

property.name: eoi
property.label: EOI
property.description: Checked on its own: only the Expression Of Interest is shown and the journey stops once it is submitted.

property.name: eoiAndFullApplication
property.label: EOI + Full Application
property.description: Checked: the EOI is shown first, then the full application opens once the EOI is submitted. This wins over the EOI checkbox. Leave both unchecked to open the full application straight away.

property.name: readOnly
property.label: Read Only
property.description: View-only mode: every field is disabled and Next/Previous only navigate — nothing is saved.

property.name: hideSteps
property.label: Hide Section Path
property.description: Hides the section path/step indicator at the top of the player.
